outputs.explanation: This is a 3D segmented rendering derived from cryo-electron tomography, showing pre-conoidal rings and a single nucleated actin filament. It is a structural/schematic rendering, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
This is a 3D rendering of the basal end of a sporozoite showing cytoplasmic actin bundles and pellicular actin. It is a structural model/schematic, not a plot, so the check is not applicable.
This is a tomographic slice (micrograph) with filaments highlighted in green, not a plot showing averaged/aggregated data. The check does not apply.
This is a 3D rendering/schematic of a lateral section showing nuclear, cytosolic and pellicular F-actin. It is not a plot of averaged data, so the check is not applicable.
This is a slice through an averaged sub-tomogram volume (a structural/density map image), not a bar chart or similar plot of averaged data points, so the check does not apply.

This is a tomographic slice (micrograph) showing a pellicular actin filament connected to a TPF by myosin-like densities (observed in two locations, N=2 noted directly in image, not as a quantitative plot). It is not a plot of averaged data, so the check is not applicable.
